text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can't believe I got hurt during training...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry! It only hurts a little! I'll
be fit as a
fiddle in no time!
choice_data_list_en: Shall we just rest for today?
Let's be more careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list_en: Pushing yourself isn't good, you know.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh... You're right. I should take it easy.

After I tend to her, we agree to take the
rest of
the day off, just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I was a little too eager to
become the top
Umamusume in all of
Japan...

After I tend to her, we agree to take the
rest of
the day off, just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not going to be discouraged by
something
like this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My mom always said that an injury is a
child's
badge of honor.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So I'm sure that this injury will become a
badge
that shows how hard I worked to
become the best
in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty, I'll focus on recovery so I can
start
training again!

After tending to Special Week's injury, I
follow
her wishes, and we continue our
training.
